build_dataset: build a tensorflow dataset by running tfds build with dataset name and data directory
create_dataset_template: create a new dataset directory from template with tfds new command and dataset name
convert_dataset_format: convert a tensorflow dataset from one file format to another using tfds convert_format
run_tfds_cli: run the tensorflow datasets CLI tool to manage and build datasets
parse_tfds_flags: parse command line flags for the tensorflow datasets CLI subcommands
